top_signals.title: Denmark Says Russia Orchestrated Assassination Plot on Rapper
top_signals.summary: Denmark’s intelligence service warned of a heightened threat from Russia, after concluding that Moscow was behind an attempted assassination on Danish soil using people linked to a local criminal gang.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japanese see current ties with China and Russia as worst on record, survey shows
top_signals.summary: Some 93% of respondents have described Japan-China relations as poor or somewhat poor, the highest since the government began posing the question.
